page.layout: One scanned image showing the outside of a book binding: a wrapped leather cover with two metal clasps on the left edge and a pasted paper label at the lower right. No printed page is visible.
page.notes: The scan shows the back board of a bound volume (limp or wrapped vellum/leather with stains, worm holes and two brass clasps with straps on the fore-edge). No printed text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is present. A blank paper label at lower right is pasted on the cover and carries no print. Nothing is transcribed.
